y-m-74-05.title: Ukuba sisebenzisa uphawu olunye olongezelelweyo, kuya kufuneka zingaphi iifoto ezongezelelweyo?
y-m-74-05.goal: Hlola ukuba xa inani leempawu likhula, inani lamaseli aahlukanisiweyo likhula ngokuphindaphinda ukuze idatha efanayo ingawazalisi amaseli, uze wenze oyilo oluninzi olufanelana nemiqathango uze unike izizathu.
y-m-74-05.material:
Iklabhu yenza i-AI ehlela iziqhamo kwiifoto. Iifoto zoqeqesho ezikhoyo zili-2,000. Amaxabiso alinganiswe kwifoto (izinto ezibonakaliswa ngamanani, ezifana nobunzima, ukukhanya kombala, ubude) abizwa 'ngeempawu'. Iqela lisombulula d iimpawu, lihlula amaxabiso eempawu nganye zibe yi-b izithuba, emva koko lenze amaseli ngokubhangqa izithuba enye ngenye. Inani lamaseli yi-b iphindaphindwe d amaxesha (b^d, 'b ukuya kwisikhuphi se-d'). Umzekelo, ukuba b = 5 kwaye d = 3, ke 5×5×5 = 125 amaseli.
Isivumelwano: iseli nganye kufuneka ibe nobuncinane iifoto ezi-5 ngomndilili ukuze sithembele kumgwebo walo seli. Cinga ukuba iifoto zisasazwe ngokulinganayo phezu kwamaseli.

y-m-74-01.title: Ukuba Utshintsha Iiyunithi, "Isiqhamo Esisondeleyo" Siseyafana?
y-m-74-01.goal: Hlukanisa ngokubala ukuba ukuba amanani eempawu zonke atshintshwa ngomlinganiselo ofanayo, "ummelwane osondeleyo" uhlala unjalo, kodwa ukuba iyunithi yempawu enye kuphela itshintshwa, inokutshintsha, uze utolike eso siphumo njengomcimbi wokukhetha iiyunithi.
y-m-74-01.material:
Usetyenziso lokuhlela iziqhamo luhlela isiqhamo esitsha njenge-'apile' okanye 'ipere'. Indlela ithi 'landela ummelwane osondeleyo'. Phakathi kweziqhamo amagama azo aziwayo, ifumana isiqhamo esisondele kakhulu ngomgama kwisiqhamo esitsha size sinike isiqhamo esitsha igama laso.
Umgama phakathi kwamanqaku amabini (x1, y1) kunye no-(x2, y2) ulinganiswa njenge-√((x1−x2)²+(y1−y2)²). (√ ifundwa 'intsika'.)
Iziqhamo ezaziwayo ngamagama (iimpawu ezimbini: ubunzima [g], ubumnandi [inani kwiiyunithi zeBrix; ngakumbi, kumnandi ngakumbi])
- Isiqhamo P: apile, ubunzima 154g, ubumnandi 12
- Isiqhamo R: ipere, ubunzima 165g, ubumnandi 16
Isiqhamo esitsha Q: ubunzima 172g, ubumnandi 12
Ingcinga: amanani eempawu ezimbini afakwa ekubaleni umgama njengoko enjalo.

y-m-74-02.material:
'Ukufunda' kwimodeli ye-AI ngumsebenzi wokufumana ixabiso w apho ilahleko (indlela eyiphosisa ngayo) ibanga lincinci. Ilahleko kulo msebenzi yi-L(w) = (w−3)², ngoko incinci, 0, xa w = 3.
Ikhompyutha ilungisa w ngolu hlobo.
w entsha = w yangoku − η × 2(w−3)
(η yizinga lokufunda, ifundwa 'eta'. 2(w−3) yintetho, sele inikiwe, malunga nendlela ilahleko etshintsha ngayo kwi-w yangoku. Faka nje amaxabiso ubale.)
I-w yokuqala yi-0, kwaye η inkulu kune-0. Umhlobo weklabhu, uHajun, wathi, "Ukuba ndisetha η ibe nkulu, ibe yi-1, ayiyi kufika ngokukhawuleza kanye?"

y-m-74-06.title: Ngubani ogqiba ukuba yeyiphi kwiividiyo A no-B ephuma kuqala?
y-m-74-06.goal: Hlola ukuba kwisikolo esidibanisa izalathisi ezimbini ukulinganiswa kutshintsha ngobunzima, yitsho ukuba kufuneka kwaziwe ntoni ngakumbi ukuze kugqitywe ukulinganiswa, uze wenze ubunzima bakho apho u-A ephuma phambili.
y-m-74-06.material:
I-app yevidiyo igqiba ukuba yeyiphi kwiividiyo ezimbini, A no-B, ekufuneka ibonakaliswe kuqala ngesikolo. Ividiyo nganye ineendlela zokulinganisa ezimbini (zombini ukusuka ku-0 ukuya ku-100).
- Ividiyo A: ingxenye ebukelwe ukuya esiphelweni (izinga lokugqiba) 80, izinga lokuthandwa 20
- Ividiyo B: izinga lokugqiba 60, izinga lokuthandwa 50
Isikolo = w1 × izinga lokugqiba + w2 × izinga lokuthandwa. I-w1 ne-w2 bubunzima obunikwe iindlela zokulinganisa ezimbini, zombini ubuncinane u-0, ne-w1 + w2 = 1. Ividiyo enesikolo esiphezulu iphuma kuqala.
Umlingane uJia uthi, "I-B inezinga lokuthandwa eliphezulu kakhulu, ngoko kunjalo i-B iphuma kuqala," yaye umlingane uDoyun uthi, "I-A inengxenye ephezulu ebukelwe ukuya esiphelweni, ngoko i-A iphuma kuqala."
